fact: INE published its Estatísticas do Comércio Externo for the first quarter of 2025, reporting a trade surplus of 3.33 trillion kwanzas, exports down 4.80% and imports up 34.71% year on year; the page does not name the record-holder, which the third-quarter 2025 edition gives as the customs and tax authority AGT plus the Ministry of Mineral Resources, Petroleum and Gas.
title: Estatísticas de Comércio Externo (ECE), I Trimestre 2025
